translation: 30 bar of grain (to) Anshan was taken, 17th year; 130 bar of grain (to) Anshan was taken, 16th year; This total bar of grain (to) Anshan was taken; Makuš received it, Umanna (is) to apportion (it).
40 bar of grain, supplied by Zimakka, to Persepolis for the (royal) stores was taken, 17th year; Ašbatašda received (it).
11 bar of barley loaves(?), supplied by Bakabada, to Persepolis was taken for the (royal) stores, 24th year.
6 (BAR of) ..... grain, supplied by Muška, was taken (to) Persepolis for the (royal) stores. 24th year.
370 (bar of grain[?]) 4 qa, to Persepolis was taken. Mannunda received (it).

3,000 bar of grain, supplied by Sunkana, from the storekeeper (=Sunkana?) was taken to Persepolis. It was delivered (for?) zimaya to Manmakka and his companion(s) at the storehouse. 22nd year, fourth and fifth (and) sixth months-for a total period of three months.
1,574 (BAR of) grain, supplied by Rauzazza, Ḫadda acquired, and took (it to) Persepolis. He acquired (it) in the eighth month, 23rd year.
1,175 bar of grain, supplied by Manyabadusz, Bakadušda received. He took (it to) Persepolis. 25th year.
323 bar of grain, supplied by Parru, was taken from (the place) Šurkutur (to the place) Bessitme. Ḫaturka received (it).
30 (BAR of grain[?]), supplied by Bakumarda, was taken (to the place) Ḫunar. Karkiš dispatched (it).
40 bar of grain, supplied by Barušiyatiš, was taken from (the place) Parmadan (to the place) Ḫunar. Azzakra received (it). 28th year, first month.
50 bar of grain, supplied by Bakadušda, was taken (to the place) Ḫutpirri. Irdabada received (it). 23rd year.
24 bar of grain was taken from (the place) Zakzaku (to the place) Liduma. Bakaduszda and Karkiš received (it). 27th year.
78 bar of grain, supplied by Nappupu, was taken (to the place) Liduma. Manaka received (it). 25th year.
30 bar of grain, supplied by Karma, (in accordance with) a sealed document of Irtuppiya, Kadukku received, and took (it to the place) Matezziš. Fourth (Elamite) month, 21st year.
30 bar of grain, supplied by Napzilla, was taken to (the place) Pumu. Manyakka received (it). 23rd year.
241 1/2 bar of grain, supplied by Ibbakama, Zabbara received, and took (it to the place) Šullakke. 22nd year.
685(?) (BAR of grain[?]) was taken (to) Shiraz.
100 bar of grain was taken from (the place) Tiliman (to the place) Zakzaku.
50 bar of grain, supplied by Parmekka, was taken (to the place) Zappi. Harriumuna received (it).
190 bar of grain, supplied by Parmekka, was taken (to the place) Zappi. Harriumuna received (it). He said(?).
175 bar of grain, supplied by Utira, was taken (to the place) Zila-Umpan. Karkiš received (it). 22nd year.
175 bar of grain, supplied by Utira, was taken (to the place) Zila-Umpan. Karkiš received (it). 23rd year.
125 1/2 bar of grain, supplied by Bakubeša, dispensed to him (i.e. to Bakubeša?), was taken (to the place) Zila-Umpan. Tiriya received (it).
360 bar of grain, supplied by Mikrašba, (in) the 22nd year, Ammarna acquired, and took (it to) Maratamkaš (GN) for the (royal) stores.
2,000 bar of grain, supplied by Basakka, Baddumaka and Manezza (and) Mantukka received, and took (it for) the (royal) stores. 28th(?) year.
64 bar of grain was taken from Anzar (Anshan?). Parruš received (it). 23rd year.
1,132 bar of grain (for making?) flour was taken (to) the nupištaš (i.e. the mill?).
316 bar of grain was taken (to) the nupištaš (i.e. the mill?).
320 bar of flour, supplied by Pirrena, to Persepolis was taken for the (royal) stores. 21st year. Bakabada received (it).
24 bar of flour to Persepolis was taken. Appišana received (it), (in) the 22nd year, for the (royal) stores.
104 bar of flour, supplied by Bakezza, to Persepolis was taken for the (royal) stores. 24th year.
584 bar of flour to Persepolis was taken. Mannunda received (it), ...
50 bar of flour Parzizi took (to the place) Bessitme, and Ḫaturka received (it). 23rd year.
200 bar of tarmu (grain) was taken from (the place) Hidali (to the place) Gisat, supplied by Hašina. Babena received (it). 23rd year.
292 bar of tarmu (grain), supplied by Umišduma, Ummanunu took (to the place) Kurdušum. 20th year.
112 bar of tarmu (grain), supplied by Umišduma, Iššante received, and took (it to the place) Kurdušum. Ḫupannana received (it). 23rd(?) year.
140 bar of tarmu (grain), supplied by Babena, Ummanunu received, and took (it to the place) Kurdušum. 23rd(?) year.
1,000 bar of tarmu (grain) was taken from (the place) Zakzaku (to the place) Šursunkiri. Pirriyašba received (it). 19th year.

310 bar of hazatiš, 390 bar of kurrusam, total 700 bar of tarmu (grain), supplied by Appumanya, was taken from (the place) Zakzaku (to the place) Šursunkiri. Pirriyašba received (it). He made beer. 22nd year.
43 marrisz (of) wine was taken from (the place) Maturban (to) Persepolis. Ziššuka took (it). 23rd year.
29 marriš of wine Appirmarša acquired, and took (it) from (the place) Rašinuzza (to) Pasargadae, (for) the royal stores.
925 marrisz (of) wine, supplied by Apzizi (lit. “upon the supplying of Apzizi”), Mannizza received. Mitranka (is) the apportioner. It was taken (to) Pasargadae.
500 (marriš of) wine, supplied by Marriyada, Zirazabbe (or “Ziraza persons”) took (to the place) Batrakataš, in the 19th year.
11 marriš (of) mariyam wine, supplied by Naprap, Bakiš received, and took (it) to the village. (He is) a messenger of Irtuppiya.
5 marriš (of) wine Ukbakurna received, and took (it to the place) Parnamatiš, for the (royal) stores.
27 marriš (of) wine, supplied by Muška, Da’uka, the mardamardam(?) of Nariyapikna, received, and took (it to the place) Parnamatiš.
30 marriš (of) wine, supplied by Ušaya, Tiššantamma received, (and) took (it to the place) Parnamatiš, for the royal food supply(?). (He is?) a mardam (of) Nariyapikna.
30 marriš (of) wine, supplied by Ušaya, Battikamasa (and) Iriššurra(?) (and) Irdaša the ansara received for rations. They took (it to the place) Parnamatiš, for the royal food supply(?).
36 marriš (of) wine, supplied by Ušaya, Barukka the “wine carrier” received. He took (it to) Umpuranuš, (for) rations (of) workers.
144 marriš of wine was taken from (the place) Maturban (to the place) Uzikurraš. Miššabadda received (it), and Mišpana took (it) for the (royal) stores. 22nd year.
206 marriš (of) wine was taken from (the place) Maturban (to the place) Uzikurrasz, for the (royal) stores. Miššabadda received (it), and Badušduš(?) the Mannaraziyan took (it). 22nd year.
2 bar of figs, supplied by Šutena, to Persepolis was taken, for the (royal) stores. Bakabada (and) Nabbaba received (it). 21st year.

49 bar of wheat, supplied by Mankeš(?) from (the place) Matezikaš (=Matezziš?), Kurizza, (for whom) Irszena (does) the apportioning, received, and took (it to) Persepolis. Manuš the grain handler (and) Manmakka his delivery man received (it). (They are) to make (i.e. defray?) its handling charge(?). 20th year. 730 bar of flour to Persepolis was taken. Upirradda and Manmakka received (it). 17th year. Umanna (is) to apportion (it at) Hatumasan(?).
n bar of wheat was taken from (the place) Rappišbena (to the place) Liduma. Bakadušda received (it). (It was) entrusted to Kinimur. 23rd year.
60 bar of sesame, supplied by Saktiti, was taken from (the place) Ullipitina (to the place) Upir. Nappupu received (it). 22nd year.
4 (sheep[?] as) tax were taken from (the place) Maturban (to) Susa. Appišuka received (them). 22nd year.

1 (male) goat, 1 ram, 4 (female) goats, 7 ewes, 4 female lambs, total 17 small cattle (at) the stockyard, supplied by Bakabana, were slaughtered. Their hides Ampirdawiš and Šakada received, and delivered (them) to the treasury (at) Hiran. 18th year.

6(?) (female) goats, 3(?) rams, total 9 small cattle, supplied by Irtam, were slaughtered. Their hides they delivered to the treasury (at) Shiraz. Šakada (and) Irtima his companion received (them). 19th year.
6 ewes, supplied by Mardonius, were slaughtered. Their hides Irtima and Šakada received, and delivered (them) to the treasury (at) Shiraz, in the first month, 21st year.
3.2 (marriš of) wine, supplied by Uštana, Bakerabba received, and utilized (it for) the abbakannuš of the abbamuš (woman) in the fourth and fifth months.
1.6 marriš (of) wine, supplied by Uštana, Bakerabba received, and utilized (it for) the abbakannuš of the abbamuš (woman). eleventh (month).
1.6 (marriš of) wine, supplied by Uštana, Bakerabba received, and utilized (it for) the abbakannuš of the abbamuš (woman); twelfth month.
25 bar of flour, supplied by Rasamada, Yamakšedda acquired, and utilized (it) for the kurakaraš; in the 18th year, sixth month.
20 bar of flour, supplied by Rasamada, Baduzarma received, and utilized (it) for the kurakaraš; 20th year.
20 bar of flour, supplied by Ištimanka, Irdapuka received; He will be utilizing (it) for the kurakaraš, (at) Kaupirriš, in the treasury, assigned by Iršena; first month, 22nd year.

25 bar of flour, supplied by Irtuppiya, Pirmayabadda(?) received; he will be utilizing (it for) the kurakaraš, at Ḫunar, in the treasury, (with) Iršena (doing) the apportioning; second month, 22nd year.
10 bar of grain, supplied by Šati-Kitin, Karsuka received, and (for?) 1 shrine(?) it was delivered. 24th year.
